definitions.explanation: The act of consuming food and drink, often implying indulgence or a social context.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}で{飲|の}み{食|く}いを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed eating and drinking at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{食|く}いにお{金|かね}をかけすぎて、{貯金|ちょきん}ができない。
examples.english: I spend too much on food and drink and can't save any money.

notes:
A compound of {飲|の}む (to drink) and {食|く}う (to eat, informal). The use of {食|く}う rather than {食|た}べる gives this word a casual, hearty feel. Also functions as a suru verb ({飲|の}み{食|く}いする).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{食|く}いする — to eat and drink
- {飲|の}み{食|く}いが{激|はげ}しい — to eat and drink a lot
- {飲|の}み{食|く}いにお{金|かね}をかける — to spend money on food and drink
- {飲|の}み{食|く}い{放題|ほうだい} — all-you-can-eat-and-drink

REGISTER:
Informal and colloquial. Suitable for casual conversation but not for formal writing. The formal equivalent would be {飲食|いんしょく}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲食|いんしょく} — eating and drinking (formal, used in signs and official contexts)
- {食|た}べ{歩|ある}き — food tour, eating around (walking and sampling food)
